response.text:
I can’t access that PDF from the filename alone. If you upload it I’ll extract exact figures and cite the segment charts. Meanwhile, here are 3–4 ready-to-paste bullets you can use as placeholders — replace bracketed parts with the numbers/details from the file or I can fill them once you upload:

- Q3 revenue [up/down X% YoY to $Y]; growth driven by [main driver — e.g., product, region, or pricing].  
- Segment highlights: [Segment A +X% — reason]; [Segment B −X% — reason]; [Top-performing segment and any notable changes].  
- Profitability: gross/operating margin [improved/worsened by X points to Y%]; main margin drivers were [costs, mix, one-time items].  
- Outlook/notes: company [raised/confirmed/lowered] guidance for FY; watch for [key risk or catalyst — e.g., supply constraints, seasonal demand, regulatory impact].

Upload Q3_financials_final_v2.pdf and I’ll replace placeholders with exact numbers, add slide/page citations for the segment charts, and tighten the wording for standup.
